def refill(self, q, evicted):
        """Move up to ``refill_batch`` staged packets into the bank's PIFO.

        The candidate set keeps the longest prefix (by rank, ordinal) that
        fits ``pifo_bytes``; the suffix is evicted in descending order.
        """
        pifo = self.pifo[q]
        used = self.pbytes[q]
        count = self.fcnt[q]
        if count:
            batch = self.batch
            fifo = self.fifo[q]
            head = self.fhead[q]
            end = len(fifo)
            stage = self.p_stage
            p_len = self.p_len
            taken = []
            append = taken.append
            freed = 0
            while count and len(taken) < batch and head < end:
                idx = fifo[head]
                head += 1
                if stage[idx] == S_FIFO:
                    self.log_set(stage, idx, S_PIFO)
                    count -= 1
                    append(idx)
                    freed += p_len[idx]
            self.fhead[q] = head
            self.fcnt[q] = count
            self.fbytes[q] = self.fbytes[q] - freed
            p_rank = self.p_rank
            for idx in taken:
                self.sl_add(pifo, (p_rank[idx], idx))
                used += p_len[idx]
        if used > self.pifo_cap:
            live = self.live
            p_len = self.p_len
            p_id = self.p_id
            stage = self.p_stage
            while used > self.pifo_cap:
                key = pifo.pop_max()
                self.record(U_DEL, pifo, key, 0, 0)
                idx = key[1]
                used -= p_len[idx]
                evicted.append(p_id[idx])
                self.sl_remove(live, key)
                self.record(U_SET, stage, idx, S_GONE, 0)
                stage[idx] = S_GONE
        self.pbytes[q] = used
